links.outcome: Clinical decision-making task performance across five sequential tasks
links.effect: ChatGPT performed better at zero temperature; Llama performed better at default temperature (no numbers given in abstract)
links.quote: Furthermore, ChatGPT performed better under the zero temperature, whereas LIama showed stronger performance under the default temperature.

links.comparator_used: Out-of-the-box prompting without MedPrompt dynamic few-shot learning
links.effect: Significantly improved relevant diagnostic testing (lowest baseline accuracy) but was counterproductive for other tasks
links.tradeoff: Performance worsened on other tasks; impact was model- and task-dependent
links.quote: While it significantly improved the performance on the task with lowest baseline accuracy (relevant diagnostic testing), it was counterproductive for others.
